text: The Patriots' Week 7 loss to the Bears—a 30-24 defeat on Thursday Night Football in Chicago where Caleb Williams threw two touchdown passes—has left the team grappling with one of Mike Vrabel's stated pillars of team identity: turnover differential, an area in which New England is clearly struggling. Drake Maye's performance warranted detailed film review, as did the team's defensive effort, though Rhamondre Stevenson provided a rare bright spot by reaching a career high in receiving yards while continuing to demonstrate the kind of consistent, detail-oriented play that's kept him on pace for his sixth straight season of 100-plus carries. The loss marks Round 2 of the matchup going to Williams and the Bears, and with postgame quotes from Vrabel and select players now available alongside the full gamebook statistics, there's plenty of material for the coaching staff to dissect as they search for answers on how to shore up the turnover issues that are holding this team back.
